summary: Muhammad Abdullah is a software engineer based in Bolton, Greater Manchester, building fast, considered web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js. This site collects {count} projects — web, systems, mobile and AI — each tracked live from its own GitHub board, alongside the degrees and roles behind them, a timeline of the route from college to production, and the tools the work is actually built with. Every section is reachable from the ring below apart from three: the full record is on the <cv>CV page</cv> and as a PDF, the reasoning behind how this site is built is written up in the <notes>engineering notes</notes>, and what this site collects — with the switch that turns the optional part off — is set out on the <privacy>privacy page</privacy>.
